summary: Fate Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement establishing an at-the-market equity program for up to $100,000,000 of common stock through Leerink Partners as sales agent under a November 5, 2026 sales agreement. No price, premium or fixed terms are set; shares sell at prevailing market prices, with the last reported Nasdaq sale at $1.61 on November 11, 2026. Leerink receives up to 3.0% commission and acts on a commercially reasonable efforts basis with no escrow. Roughly 106,155 shares (~$176,812) were already sold under a prior shelf; this is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution and share overhang versus cash runway.
